verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਬੇਲ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਚੰਬੇਲੀ ਗਤਿ ਮੂਲ ਸਾਖਾ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕਰ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਹੈ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham gur bel haivai cha(n)belee gat mool saakhaa patr kar bibidh bithaar hai||

en.bdb: Satguru, manifestation of Almighty God, is like jasmine creeper of which He Himself is the root and all His devotees and pious persons are its leaves and branches.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਪੁਹਪ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪ ਤਾ ਮੈਂ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਕਰਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੋ ਉਧਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurusikh puhap subaas nij roop taa mai(n) pragaT haivai karat sa(n)saar ko udhaar hai ||

en.bdb: Pleased at the services of His devotees (like Bhai Lehna Ji, Baba Amar Das Ji, etc.) Satguru turns those devotees by His grace and makes them into fragrance-spreading flowers and by manifesting in them is liberating the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕਰ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਫੁਲੇਰ ਮਹਿਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: til mil baasanaa subaas ko nivaas kar aapaa khoi hoi hai fuler mahikaar hai ||

en.bdb: Just as sesame seed loses its existence and becomes scent when unites with the fragrance of the flowers, the devotees too lose themselves to the Lord through meditation and spread divine fragrance in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਮਂੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਰੀਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੩੭॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag ma(n)ai patit puneet reet sa(n)saaree havai nira(n)kaaree paraupakaar hai ||37||

en.bdb: Sikhism has a tradition of changing sinners into holy persons. And in this path, this is a very righteous task and service towards others. Those engrossed in material world are converted into God-loving and godly persons. They are detached from maya (mammon) and united with the Almighty. (37)
